headline: Brent Crude Hovers Near Monthly High on Middle East Supply Risks
summary: Brent crude futures hovered near monthly highs, trading around $96.19 a barrel, as attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi infrastructure heightened supply fears.
why: Geopolitical disruptions in key Middle East shipping chokepoints directly threaten international petroleum flows and drive global crude volatility.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Attacks on tankers and regional energy infrastructure create supply shortage fears, supporting crude prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Continued attacks on oil tankers and energy infrastructure in the Middle East exacerbated concerns over potential export restrictions and physical shortages.
